backend.title: Backend Engineer
backend.description: Implements server-side behavior, APIs, authorization, business rules, and focused tests.

frontend.title: Frontend Engineer
frontend.description: Implements accessible and responsive UI features following the project's design system.

frontend-tester.title: Frontend Tester
frontend-tester.description: Reviews browser workflows, accessibility, responsiveness, and interface regressions without changing application code.

database.title: Database Engineer
database.description: Designs schemas, queries, migrations, transactions, and data-integrity protections for the project database.

devops.title: DevOps / SRE Engineer
devops.description: Reviews and implements reproducible builds, CI/CD, observability, and safe deployment procedures.

integration-tester.title: Integration / Regression Tester
integration-tester.description: Tests cross-component workflows and failure modes using isolated fixtures and test data.

security.title: Security Specialist
security.description: Independently reviews attack surfaces, authentication, authorization, secrets, dependencies, and vulnerabilities.

performance.title: Performance Engineer
performance.description: Profiles and diagnoses latency, CPU, memory, I/O, concurrency and query performance.

ux-designer.title: UX Designer
ux-designer.description: Evaluates user flows, accessibility, design consistency, and interaction tradeoffs.

documentation.title: Documentation Engineer
documentation.description: Maintains user guides, API documentation, developer onboarding, and operational runbooks.

auditor-advisor.title: Independent Auditor / Advisor
auditor-advisor.description: Performs deep independent architecture, correctness, reliability, security and technical decision reviews.

circuit-designer.title: Circuit Designer
circuit-designer.description: Designs and edits KiCad 10 schematics (.kicad_sch): circuit topology, protection, component values and the calculations behind them.

pcb-layout.title: PCB Layout Engineer
pcb-layout.description: Creates and edits KiCad 10 PCB layouts (.kicad_pcb): placement, routing, board outline, zones and design rules.

component-engineer.title: Component Engineer
component-engineer.description: Researches and validates parts, datasheets, symbols, footprints and the BOM; maintains project-local KiCad libraries when assigned.

electrical-verifier.title: Electrical Verification Engineer
electrical-verifier.description: Runs KiCad ERC and DRC with schematic parity, inspects reports and checks rails, pinouts and ratings without editing design files.

hardware-auditor.title: Independent Hardware Auditor
hardware-auditor.description: Independently reviews electronics architecture, safety, power, thermal, EMC, testability and PCB design; read-only.

pcb-manufacturing.title: PCB Manufacturing / DFM Engineer
pcb-manufacturing.description: Checks fabrication and assembly readiness and stages Gerber and drill outputs for human review; never places orders.

firmware.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
firmware.description: Writes firmware, pin maps, peripheral setup and board-support code and checks them against the schematic.

hardware-bringup.title: Hardware Bring-up Engineer
hardware-bringup.description: Writes staged power-up and test procedures, expected rail values, test-point maps and fault-isolation plans for prototypes.

power-electronics.title: Power Electronics Specialist
power-electronics.description: Analyzes converters, power distribution, batteries, inrush, dissipation, loop stability and protection.

signal-integrity.title: Signal Integrity / EMC Specialist
signal-integrity.description: Reviews high-speed links, stackup, impedance, return paths, grounding, decoupling and EMC risk.

cad-engineer.title: Parametric CAD Engineer
cad-engineer.description: Creates and revises native FreeCAD .FCStd parametric parts with constrained sketches, clear feature trees and reproducible Python sources.

mechanical-engineer.title: Mechanical Engineer
mechanical-engineer.description: Evaluates loads, materials, tolerance stacks, fastening and thermal expansion; changes geometry only when delegated.

assembly-engineer.title: Assembly Engineer
assembly-engineer.description: Manages part relationships, mating interfaces, fasteners, alignment, motion envelopes and assembly clearances in FreeCAD.

electronics-enclosure.title: Electronics Enclosure Engineer
electronics-enclosure.description: Designs PCB enclosures in FreeCAD: bosses, inserts, connector openings, cable paths, ventilation and mounting.

printability-engineer.title: Printability Engineer
printability-engineer.description: Assesses FDM orientation, supports, wall thickness, nozzle limits, bridges, material behavior and print tolerances without editing CAD.

slicer-specialist.title: Slicer Specialist
slicer-specialist.description: Prepares STL/3MF exports for OrcaSlicer, checks the printer profile and produces G-code only on explicit request; never starts prints.

cad-verifier.title: CAD Verification Engineer
cad-verifier.description: Independently checks recomputed FreeCAD models: shape validity, solid count, dimensions, build volume and export integrity, without editing CAD.

mechanical-auditor.title: Independent Mechanical Auditor
mechanical-auditor.description: Independently reviews mechanical design decisions, strength assumptions, fit, tolerances, safety and print strategy; read-only.
